card.name: Filter pore size digits like 0.2 micron
card.fires_on: The digit after "0." in the pore size of an in-line IV filter, mostly the 2 in "0.2 micron", right before the word micron or a micron-range unit.

modes.label: 0.2 micron filter

modes.example: Infusion sets with an in-line 0.<<2>>2 micron filter should be used.
